The initializer, snapshot ownership, concurrency and passive-store drivers in this directory require the historical host from their matching evidence. They do not qualify the current automatic readonly static container. Current construction and configuration checks run in the native EnvironmentOptionsProcessTests, ConfigurationProcessTests, ConfigurationValidationProcessTests and ConfigurationPathProcessTests classes through eng/test.ps1.
